title: Anthrax101's Bindle
description: It turns the filled bundle into a bindle. Simple as.
body:
The Bindle resource pack replaces a filled bundle with a bindle, the proper term for a bundle on a stick.
Idea by itsmejames on twitter

I really gotta make a mark on this site...
